title: Proton Swap! — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Acids and bases for CHEM 3A (Chapter 12), built on Dr. Dan's Lectures 26–27: identifying acids and bases, strong vs. weak (particle beaker with a conductivity bulb), pH Lab with litmus, phenolphthalein and universal indicator, typed pH/pOH/[H+]/[OH-] calculations with the log sig-fig rule, Arrhenius and Brønsted–Lowry definitions and conjugate pairs, a titration lab with a buret and live titration curve, a buffer lab comparing water with real buffers including blood, and a 10-question Skill Check with a study plan.
